title: Kinematic MeanFlow: One-Step Action Generation Policy for Robotic Foundation Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.00864v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In this paper, we study how to achieve one-step action generation in Robotic Foundation Models (RFMs), aiming to overcome the high inference latency of multi-step flow matching. MeanFlow provides a promising framework for this goal, yet its direct application leads to performance collapse. We discover that this stems from two distinctive dynamics exhibited in the RFM velocity field: (1) the ``local acceleration" exhibits stability early on, but surges sharply towards the end of the denoising process, and (2) the spread of its magnitudes across samples widens as denoising progresses. To address these issues, we introduce Kinematic MeanFlow (K-MF), a novel one-step action policy tailored for RFMs. Specifically, grounded in a kinematic identity, K-MF decouples the time derivative term in the MeanFlow formulation into two sub-interval terms separated by an intermediate point. translated_title: 运动学MeanFlow：面向机器人基础模型的单步动作生成策略
translated_abstract: 本文研究如何在机器人基础模型中实现单步动作生成，旨在克服多步流匹配带来的高推理延迟问题。MeanFlow为实现这一目标提供了有前景的框架，但直接应用会导致性能崩溃。我们发现这源于机器人基础模型速度场所表现出的两个独特动力学特性：（1）“局部加速度”在去噪过程早期保持稳定，但在接近尾声时急剧激增；（2）其幅值在不同样本间的分布范围随着去噪的进行而不断扩大。为解决这些问题，我们提出了运动学MeanFlow（K-MF），这是一种专为机器人基础模型量身定制的全新单步动作策略。具体而言，基于运动学恒等式，K-MF将MeanFlow公式中的时间导数项解耦为由一个中间点分隔的两个子区间项。这种解耦的公式使得这两项能够分别捕捉早期和后期的动力学特性……
tldr: 提出面向机器人基础模型的单步动作生成策略Kinematic MeanFlow（K-MF），通过运动学恒等式将MeanFlow的时间导数项解耦为两个子区间项，解决了直接应用MeanFlow导致的性能崩溃问题，从而克服多步流匹配的高推理延迟。
en_tdlr: Kinematic MeanFlow (K-MF) enables one-step action generation for Robotic Foundation Models by decoupling the time derivative term in MeanFlow into two sub-interval terms via a kinematic identity, resolving the performance collapse of directly applying MeanFlow and overcoming the high inference latency of multi-step flow matching.
